question:
Choose the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

We cannot always follow instructions exactly, sometimes we need to __**incorporate**__ our own ideas.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"incorporate"** means to include or integrate a part into the whole. (शामिल करना)

 
 
• **Example:** We need to **incorporate** new strategies to improve our sales.
 
 
 
• **"Integrate"** refers to combining one thing with another to form a whole. (एकीकृत करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The new policy aims to** integrate **immigrants into the community.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'incorporate**' is **'integrate'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Exclude** (बहिष्कृत करना): To leave out or not include.

 
 
• **Example:** The new policy will** exclude** temporary workers from the benefits.
 
 
 
• **Part** (हिस्सा): A piece or segment of something.
 
 
• **Example:** This **part **of the project is particularly challenging.
 
 
 
• **Separate** (अलग करना): To set or keep apart.
 
 
• **Example:** We need to **separate** the recyclable materials from the trash.
